bio.text: Maritza Davila represents Assembly District 53 and was appointed chair of the Assembly Committee on Social Services as of January 2023, according to her official biography.
She was born in Catano, Puerto Rico, moved to Bushwick as a girl, and has lived there since.

She served as president of the Community School District 32 board of education, joined the Ridgewood Bushwick Senior Citizens Council in 1996, and earned an A.A. in political science from Long Island University in 2013.
